summary: Combined photoelectric sensor form: FORM C Emitter-Receiver AC Driven 5 PIN.
description: A combined photoelectric sensor contains an emitter and a receiver within the same documented sensing unit. This entry identifies the form c emitter-receiver ac driven 5 pin form in the publisher's IEC-context family.

A reflective sensing arrangement can detect a passing object or a change in returned light and send the result to a control input. Form C identifies a changeover output with a common and two alternative paths; it does not establish which terminal numbers the selected device uses. The additional connection points need the actual pin assignment. A fourth or fifth pin may serve an output or control function; pin count alone does not define its purpose.

This is the AC-supplied form. Supply and switched output must be checked separately rather than substituting a DC sensor connection diagram. The combined housing does not establish whether a reflector or the target returns the light. Sensing mode, light-on or dark-on selection and pin functions need the selected product diagram.
